# Zyyvor API

> Free REST API platform with 400++ endpoints for modern developers. No API key required.

Zyyvor is a comprehensive REST API platform providing 400++ endpoints across categories including AI chat, image processing, media downloaders, payment tools, games, and developer utilities. Built on Node.js with Express, deployed on Cloudflare with 99.99% uptime.

## Base URL

All API endpoints are available at:

    https://api.zyvor.my.id/api/

## Authentication

Most endpoints require no authentication. Premium endpoints require an API key via:
- Header: `X-API-Key: your-key`
- Query: `?apikey=your-key`
- Bearer: `Authorization: Bearer your-key`

## Rate Limits

- 20,000 requests per day per IP address (free tier)
- Premium endpoints have higher limits

## API Categories

### AI Chat (47 endpoints)
AI chat with multiple models: GPT-4o, Gemini, DeepSeek, Claude, Qwen, Mistral, and more.
- `/api/ai/gpt4o` - GPT-4o Mini chat
- `/api/ai/gemini` - Google Gemini chat
- `/api/ai/deepseek` - DeepSeek V3 chat
- `/api/ai/claude-v2` - Claude Sonnet chat
- `/api/ai/qwen` - Qwen V2 chat
- `/api/ai/mistral` - Mistral AI chat

### Image Processing (14 endpoints)
- `/api/image/blur` - Gaussian blur
- `/api/image/removebg` - Remove background
- `/api/image/toanimev2` - Convert to anime style
- `/api/image/upscaler` - Image upscaling

### Media Downloaders (26 endpoints)
Download from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Spotify, and more.
- `/api/downloader/youtube2` - YouTube video download
- `/api/downloader/tiktokv2` - TikTok video download
- `/api/downloader/spotify` - Spotify music download
- `/api/downloader/instagram` - Instagram media download

### Tools (27 endpoints)
Developer utilities including QR codes, DNS lookup, screenshots, and more.
- `/api/tools/text2qr` - Text to QR code
- `/api/tools/ssweb` - Website screenshot
- `/api/tools/trackip` - Domain/IP intelligence: DNS records, IP trace, subdomain finder
- `/api/tools/ocr` - Optical character recognition

### Games (27 endpoints)
Quiz and trivia games in Indonesian.
- `/api/games/tebakgambar` - Guess the picture
- `/api/games/family100` - Family 100 style quiz
- `/api/games/math` - Math quiz

### Search (20 endpoints)
- `/api/search/wikipedia` - Wikipedia search
- `/api/search/pinterest` - Pinterest search
- `/api/search/spotify` - Spotify search

### Payment (11 endpoints)
QRIS payment, GoPay, and top-up services.
- `/api/payment/qris-static` - Generate QRIS code
- `/api/topup/ff` - Free Fire top-up

## Response Format

All responses use JSON format:

```json
{
  "status": true,
  "data": { ... }
}
```

## Documentation

Full interactive documentation with playground:

    https://api.zyvor.my.id/docs
